sourceSemantics.rule: Null Task constructor throws ArgumentNullException(task). Task backing uses token0; predicates mirror Task, direct GetResult waits/rethrows via Task, AsTask returns original Task. Equality compares backing identity/token and hash invokes backing virtual hash. Compare hash relations rather than cross-runtime numeric hashes.

Default AsTask uses CompletedTask; default Preserve stays completed. Task-backed Preserve retains backing Task. Source-backed Preserve converts via AsTask into a durable Task-backed value. Java ValueTask object reference identity is not native struct identity.

GetStatus runs once outside catch. Every non-Pending status consumes GetResult once synchronously. Normal result yields CompletedTask even when status says Faulted/Canceled/unknown. A thrown result is classified using previously read status, not exception type alone.

Canceled status plus OCE stores original exception and its token, even if token unsignaled; repeated awaits rethrow same OCE. Canceled status plus ordinary exception discards that fault and uses pre-canceled token, producing TCE on awaiting. Non-canceled status plus OCE stays faulted with original identity. Canceled Task.Exception is null.

Pending conversion registers exactly one callback with original token and None flags, returning an owned pending promise without blocking. Callback checks state/source, clears retained source, reads status once, consumes result once, and completes using the status-directed rules. Initialized adapter must support inline callback during OnCompleted.

Initial GetStatus and OnCompleted exceptions escape AsTask synchronously. Callback GetStatus exception escapes callback invocation and leaves Task pending. Sequential duplicate callback or null/wrong state throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException(state) before another consumption. Exact private native state-string/ActualValue rendering is a Java representation boundary; stable type/parameter/resource checks stay paired.

Task-backed normal/configured awaiters delegate completion/result/registration. Null continuation validation follows Task route. Existing source flags remain3/1/3/2/1/0. Late Task registration queues; pending first callback may inline in existing default-context shallow-stack profile. No-context tests do not establish custom context or execution-flow parity.

Original source-backed ValueTask is not reusable after conversion. Repeated await and continuation tests target one returned Task or one preserved value. Do not prescribe repeated AsTask/Preserve on a consumed reusable source, awaiting original after conversion, or arbitrary concurrent duplicate callbacks as supported behavior. Diagnostic repeatable sources can expose per-call flow without generalizing reuse guarantees.

consumption: Original source-backed value is consumed once. Durable tests use only returned Task/preserved ValueTask. No arbitrary concurrent duplicate callback contract.
